cases.question: How many customers do we have?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers;

cases.question: Can you list the names of all our customers in Pakistan?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT full_name FROM customers WHERE country = 'Pakistan';

cases.question: Which products are completely out of stock right now?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE in_stock = 0;

cases.question: What are our cheapest and most expensive product prices?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT MIN(unit_price) AS cheapest_price, MAX(unit_price) AS most_expensive_price FROM products;

cases.question: What different categories of products do we sell?
How many orders has each customer placed?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT c.full_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name;

cases.question: How many orders came in between the 1st of June and the 31st of August 2024?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-06-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31';

cases.question: Which three products have made us the most money in total, and how much?
cases.expected_sql:
SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 3;

cases.question: Which products cost more than the average price of everything we sell?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT name, unit_price FROM products WHERE unit_price > (SELECT AVG(unit_price) FROM products);

cases.question: Which customers have placed more than one order?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT c.full_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 1;

cases.question: Which cities do we have customers in who have had at least one order delivered?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.city FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered';

cases.question: Which customer has spent the most money on orders that were actually delivered, and how much did they spend?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT c.full_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 1;

cases.question: Which categories of products has Ayesha Karim bought from?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.category FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE c.full_name = 'Ayesha Karim';

cases.question: Which customers have never bought anything from the Peripherals category?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT c.full_name FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND p.category = 'Peripherals');

cases.question: Which orders are worth more than the average order, and what is each one worth?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS order_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) > (SELECT AVG(t.order_value) FROM (SELECT SUM(oi2.quantity * oi2.unit_price) AS order_value FROM order_items oi2 GROUP BY oi2.order_id) t);
